population: Use the complete R5 Japanese J1 regular-season panel and signed R7/R10 controls. Retain every fixture in each scoring window including missing half scores. Use only official regulation FT with both team IDs and the two original ESPN half scores summing to each final. Keep the separately reviewed Nov 25 seven outside training and validation. No target fixture half score is available to any prediction.
calendar: Use the R15 time bounds 2024-01-01, 2025-01-01, 2026-01-01. Fit before 2024, select separate heads on 2024, evaluate on the full 2025 J1 panel, and quote the later R5 recent J1 panel separately. Include the full Japanese regular-season cohort as registered in R5 per its actual dates. Historical reconstructions have no certified historical first-known timestamps.
estimate: Fit home and away first-half shares separately using (first-half goals + 40*0.45)/(full-match goals + 40). Estimate common second-half scoring multipliers for the team leading or trailing at half time on the same training data. Denominator is the side's strictly pregame unfitted R7 anchor mean times its second-half fraction. Pool the two venue sides by own leading/trailing state, shrink each ratio (observed+20)/(expected+20) and bound it to [0.5,2]. At a halftime draw the multiplier is 1. Do not tune these choices on evaluation or recent results.
prematch: For each signed R7 matrix compute its two marginal mean goals. Integrate over all possible first-half score pairs, weighting independent Poisson first-half rates equal to those marginal means times the trained shares. Conditional second-half goal laws are independent Poisson by team, using the appropriate leading/trailing multipliers. On the existing finite score lattice transfer the ratio of the integrated score law to the otherwise identical law with both multipliers equal to one. Renormalize once. The zero adjustment exactly inherits the signed control and its ordered picks including a local tie. Only prematch R7 inputs and training parameters may enter this calculation.
selection: Compare R7, fixed-full state adjustment, fitted intensity candidate, R10 and original same-game market. Before evaluation choose independent doses in {0,0.5,1} by the existing R10 decision.choose on the validation calendar for exact scores, WDL and actual OU. Score selection uses first hits, three hits, score log loss and the smaller dose in order. Report complete denominators and same-match gains/losses with date-cluster uncertainty, including unavailable market/OU, rank movement, goals 1-1/2-2, and all top-three seats and short days. Retain state fit even if validation chooses zero. No stage promotion from retrospective data.
forward: Refit state coefficients on the complete R5 historical panel through 2026-11-21, keeping 2024-selected head intensities fixed. Use the ten signed R18 November 28-29 fixtures and their unchanged signed R7 grids and market lines. Freeze a new research first per fixture before earliest kickoff and rank three by the chosen first cell probability with original kickoff then match ID tie-break. Keep previously published Current/Test/comprehensive, R15, R18, R19 and their prior seats. Only later outcomes can establish prospective gains.
